definitions.explanation: A determined or persistent attitude, refusing to give in.
A sense of self-respect that prevents yielding to others.

examples.japanese: {意地|いじ}{悪|わる}なことを{言|い}う。
{意地|いじ}でも{諦|あきら}めない。
examples.english: I won't give up no matter what.

notes:
{意地|いじ} relates to stubbornness, pride, or disposition.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意地|いじ}を{張|は}る (to be stubborn)
- {意地|いじ}が{悪|わる}い (mean-spirited)
- {意地|いじ}でも (no matter what, stubbornly)
- {意地|いじ}になる (to become stubborn)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {意地悪|いじわる}: meanness, spite
- {食|く}い{意地|いじ}: gluttony, greediness for food

NOTE:
- Different from {維持|いじ} (maintenance) - same reading, different kanji
